title: CERT-In Advisory   CIAD-2026-0057
content:
CERT-In Advisory  
                                                                      CIAD-2026-0057
Multiple vulnerabilities in GoAhead Web Server
Original Issue Date: October   28, 2026
Severity Rating: Critical
Software Affected
GoAhead Web Server versions 3.4.5 to 6.1.0 with OpenSSL TLS build
GoAhead Web Server versions 4.0.2 to 6.1.0 with Mbed TLS build
GoAhead Web Server versions 6.1.0 and prior with LibreSSL Legacy TLS build
Overview
Multiple vulnerabilities have been reported in GoAhead Web Server which could allow a remote attacker to bypass security restrictions, obtain sensitive information, decrypt certain TLS-encrypted communications, or unauthorized access to affected services on the targeted system.
Target Audience:
All organizations and Individuals using GoAhead Web Server.
Risk Assessment:
High risk of bypassing security restrictions and obtaining sensitive information.
Impact Assessment:
Potential for unauthorized access, disclosure of sensitive information, and compromise of affected systems.
Description
GoAhead is an embedded web server used for device management in various IoT, firewall, and industrial control devices.
These vulnerabilities exist in GoAhead due to improper certificate validation.
Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to bypass security restrictions, obtain sensitive information, decrypt certain TLS-encrypted communications, or unauthorized access to affected services on the targeted system.
Solution
Apply appropriate updates as mentioned by the vendor:
https://www.embedthis.com/goahead/
